hero.description: Global Opportunities ihuriza hamwe amahirwe y'imfashanyo, amatangazo y'imigambi, ibibazo, isuzuma, ugutanga imfashanyo n'ukurikirana ubwishuru mu kibanza c'akazi kimwe gitekanye kandi gikoreshwa mu ndimi nyinshi. Uwufise umugambi aronka itangazo, ategura umugambi ahuza n'ibisabwa vyayo nyakuri, arasaba, hanyuma akurikirana imfashanyo gushika ku nzira y'ugutanga — ata gutakaza inzira mu masanduku menshi y'ubutumwa.

trust.description: Inimero zose ziri hejuru zerekana urubuga nk'uko rwubatswe uyu munsi. Nta kimwe ari inimero z'abayikoresha, kuko ata makuru y'ukoresha yagenzuwe arahari.
trust.assurance: Umutekano usobanurwa n'ivyo urubuga rukora — ikiringo c'ukwinjira gishingiye ku tweme, ibandiko bijanye n'umugambi, uburenganzira bushingiye ku nshingano — atari ku bimenyetso bitarahawe.
details: Urutonde rw'urubuga mu ndimi zine: icongereza, igifaransa, ikirundi n'ikiswahili.
Menya ukoresheje Monitor — urugendo rwose kuva ku mahirwe gushika ku ngaruka.
Ibice vy'akazi vyishura amatangazo, imigambi, ibibazo, imfashanyo n'ibandiko.
Inshingano z'abafatanyi urubuga rwubakiye, kuva ku musaba gushika ku muyobozi.

features.title: Ivyose inzira ikeneye, mu kibanza kimwe c'akazi.
features.description: Gushakisha ni aho uwufise umugambi atangurira. Ibikurikira vyose — gutegura umugambi, gusaba, gusuzumwa, guhabwa imfashanyo, kwishurwa no kwerekana icahindutse — bikorwa kuri iyo nyandiko imwe aho kuba mu buryo bushasha buri gihe.
details: Urutonde rumwe rushakishwa rw'amahirwe y'imfashanyo n'amatangazo, ruhitamwo ku bwoko, ishami, aho biri n'ikigero.
Inyandiko y'umugambi iteguye ifise intego, ibisubizo, ingengo y'imari n'ibandiko, kugira ngo umugambi utegurwe rimwe gusa kandi ukoreshwe kenshi.
Ibibazo bifise ikigero n'amateka, kugira ngo umusaba amenye igihe ihinduka ryiwe rigereye.
Ibisabwa biteguye, isuzuma ryatanzwe n'ingingo yanditswe, kugira ngo uguhitamo gusobanuke aho kuba mu mwijima.
Imfashanyo yatanzwe n'igice cose catanzwe bikurikiranwa ku mugambi, n'igice gikurikira kigaragara.
Ubwishuru bwanditswe ku gice catanzwe, butanga ku mpande zose iyerekwa rimwe ry'ivyishuwe n'ibitarishurwa.
Ibandiko bishizwe rimwe, bishizwe mu bwoko, kandi bisangirwa gusa n'abafatanyabikorwa bajanye n'umugambi.
Ivyibutsa vy'itariki iheruka, imenyesha y'ingingo n'ikigero c'ibandiko bigera ku bantu babikeneye.
Inyishu zisobanutse ku mahirwe, ku bisabwa vy'ukwemerwa no ku bandiko — zishingiye ku makuru yemewe.

showcase.description: Buri rupapuro ruri hepfo rwakozwe mu bice bimwe nk'uru rupapuro. Igihinduka hagati yavyo ni umufatanyi: umusaba arondera amatangazo, uwufise umugambi acunga ugutanga, uwutanga imfashanyo akurikirana impfashanyo yatanzwe.

how.title: Intambwe icenda, inzira imwe ihoraho.
how.description: Buri rupapuro, imenyesha n'uburenganzira mu rubuga bihura n'imwe muri izi ntambwe icenda. Ni co gituma umugambi, ikibazo cawo, imfashanyo yawo n'ivyerekanwa vyawo bisobanura ikintu kimwe.
details: Shakisha mu rutonde rw'amatangazo afunguye hanyuma uhitamwo ayo ahuye n'ishami, aho biri n'itariki iheruka.
Soma incamake, ibisabwa vy'ukwemerwa, ibandiko bisabwa n'itariki iheruka kuri buri tangazo wahisemwo.
Tegura inyandiko y'umugambi: intego, ibisubizo bitegerejwe, ingengo y'imari, itsinda n'ibandiko bishigikira.
Tanga umugambi ku itangazo. Ikibazo cakira ibandiko vy'umugambi aho kubisaba ukundi.
Isuzuma rikorwa ku bisabwa biteguye, kandi buri suzuma ryandikwa ku nshingano yaryo.
Ingingo y'uguhitamo yandikwa ku kibazo kandi impande zose ziramenyeshwa.
Imfashanyo yatanzwe ijangwa ku mugambi hamwe n'urugendo rw'ugutanga igice umusaba ashobora kubona.
Ubwishuru bwandikwa ku gice cose catanzwe, bukagifunga uko igikorwa gitangwa.
Ibikorwa, ibimenyetso n'ibandiko biguma bigaragara ku mugambi mu buzima bwawo bwose, atari gusa gushika ku itariki iheruka.
outputs: Ingingo isobanutse yo kuja canke kutaja

benefits.title: Ivyo hinduka iyo inzira yose iri mu kibanza kimwe.
items: Uko urubuga rukoreshwa mu ndimi nyinshi
benefits.description: Igice kinini c'ibibazo mu gusaba imfashanyo si ukwandika. Ni ukuronka itangazo, kumenya ivyo risaba, kubika ibandiko mu rutonde, no kumenya ivyabaye. Aha ni ahantu umunani urubuga rukuraho akazi.
details: Amatangazo ava ku batanga bose mu rutonde rumwe, n'ibihitamo bimwe, aho kuba amasanduku n'imbuga nyinshi.
Ibandiko bijanwa ku mugambi rimwe gusa bikagenda n'ikibazo, kugira ngo nta kintu gisubirizwe gushirwa kuri buri tangazo.
Umugambi ni inyandiko ifise intego, ibisubizo, ingengo y'imari n'aho bigeze, atari idosiye y'amafishiye yitwa ukundi.
Ibisabwa, amanota n'ingingo biraboneka, kugira ngo umusaba abone igituma ikibazo ciwe cemejwe canke kidemewe.
Imfashanyo yatanzwe, igice gikurikira n'ivyishuwe biraboneka ku mpande zose icarimwe.
Ibandiko bishizwe mu bwoko, birasuzumwa kandi bijanye n'umugambi aho kuba bikwiragiye mu butumwa.
Umukoresha akora mu kiswahili asoma urubuga rumwe n'umukoresha akora mu gifaransa, mu rurimi rwiwe.
Umufasha asobanura itangazo, atanga urutonde rw'ibandiko bikenewe kandi ahindura ibice vy'ikoranabuhanga.

ecosystem.description: Urubuga ni inyandiko isangiwe. Umufatanyi wese abona igice ashinzwe, kandi ukwiyamirira kwose hagati yabo ni intambwe ku mugambi umwe aho kuba ubutumwa mu nzira itandukanye.
actorDetails: Bashira mu ngiro imigambi, bafise inyandiko z'imigambi, kandi babona ibibazo vyabo n'imfashanyo mu kibanza kimwe.
Batangaza amahirwe, bashinga ibisabwa, bagena isuzuma, batanga imfashanyo kandi bageneza ugutanga ibice.
Bahuza umugambi mu itsinda, bafise inyandiko imwe abose bayitanzeho.
Baronka itangazo, bategura umugambi ku ryo, barasaba, kandi bakurikirana ico bisubije intambwe ku ntambwe.
Basuzuma ibibazo vyatanzwe ku bisabwa vyatangajwe kandi bandika isuzuma ryahawe amanota.
Bagenzura amashirahamwe, bacunga inshingano, kandi bagenzura ibikorwa n'inyandiko z'urubuga.

ai.boundary: Umufasha asobanukiriza amakuru y'urubuga. Ntashobora gufata icemezo c'imfashanyo, c'itorwa canke c'ubwemezo bwa nyuma.

conversation.placeholder: Baza ibijanye n'ibisabwa vy'ukwemerwa, ibandiko canke itariki iheruka

ai.description: Baza ikibazo mu rurimi urwo ari rwo rwose mu ndimi zine z'urubuga. Umufasha akorera ku makuru y'urubuga bwite — itangazo, ibisabwa vyaryo, ibandiko vyaryo — aho kuba ku kiyago gitagira aho gishingiye.
capabilityDetails: Kuvuga mu ncamake ivyo itangazo rigamije, abo rifunguriwe n'ivyo rizofasha.
Guhindura igice kigoye c'ukwemerwa urutonde rw'ibibazo ushobora gusubiza.
Gutanga urutonde rw'ibandiko itangazo risaba no kwerekana ibitakiri mu mugambi wawe.
Kugabanya inyandiko ndende y'itangazo gushika ku bice bikora ku shirahamwe ryawe.
Gutanga ibisobanuro mu rurimi umusomyi ari gukorera.
Gutambutsa intambwe ikurikira y'ikibazo, mu buryo, nta kintu catawe.

assistant: Noshobora kugufasha gusuzuma ibisabwa vyemewe. Ku mfashanyo y'abaturage, ibintu bibiri akenshi bigena ukwemerwa ni iyandikwa ryemewe n'umwaka umwe w'ibikorwa vyanditswe.
Amatangazo menshi asaba bitatu: icemezo c'iyandikwa, integuro y'akazi yashizweko umukono n'ingengo y'imari. Fungura itangazo, hanyuma urupapuro rw'ibandiko rwerekana ivyo ufise n'ibitakiriho.

points.interface: Imikurikiranyo, buto, amazina y'ibintu n'imitwe yose yahinduwe, atari umutwe w'urupapuro gusa.
points.search: Gushakisha no guhitamo bikora kimwe mu ndimi zose, harimo Kirundi na Kiswahili.
points.storage: Igihitamo cawe kibikwa kuri aka gikoresho, kandi ururimi rw'urupapuro rurangwa, kugira ngo ibikoresho bisoma urupapuro n'ubuhinduzi bw'abasomyi bikore neza.
points.add: Ururimi rwa gatanu ni ukongera mu katalogi gusa. Nta gice c'igikoresho cahinduka, kandi nta kongera kwubaka urupapuro ubwaco.

languages.description: Urubuga ruraboneka mu congereza, igifaransa, ikirundi n'ikiswahili. Umusomyi ashobora gushakisha, guhitamwo, kubika no gutanga atava mu rurimi yatanguye, kandi umuyobozi ashobora kongeramo ururimi rwa gatanu atakoze ku gice na kimwe c'urubuga.

testimonials.title: Byanditswe ku ntambwe zisanzwe zitera ikibazo.
testimonials.notice: Ingero z'ibitekerezo vy'abakoresha. Nta mukoresha yavuzwe kugeza ubu; hindura aya majambo n'ayo umukoresha yemeye mbere yo kutangaza.
quotes: Narakoresha urutonde rw'amatangazo mu rupapuro rw'ibara ryahise rishaje. Ubu itariki iheruka, ibandiko n'aho ikibazo canje kigereye biri ku rupapuro rumwe, kandi nareka gukorera ku kwibuka.
Dutangaza itangazo rimwe hanyuma tubona buri kibazo ku bisabwa bimwe. Abagenzuzi ntibongera kuduha amanota mu butumwa, kandi dushobora gusubiza ikibazo c'umusaba ata kurondera urudodo.
Nahawe ibibazo vyihariye, ntibansabwa kubironka. Amanota yanje ari ku bisabwa vyatangajwe, kugira ngo ingingo ntanga ishobore gusobanurwa ku woyibaza wese.

impact.title: Kuva mu gushakisha bitateganye kugera ku nzira ikurikiranwa.
items: Ubuhambwe bwagutse hagati y'abafise imigambi n'abatanga imfashanyo
impact.description: Impinduka zitanu, mu rutonde zibaho. Buri imwe ni ikivugwa ku kuntu urubuga rukora, atari ikipimo c'ukuntu rukora neza, kandi ni ubwoko bw'ivugwa bushoboka gusa imbere y'ugutangura.
details: Itangazo ryari kwibagirwa mu masanduku yuzuye ubu rironka ukoresheje igihitamo n'ikimenyetso c'itariki iheruka.
Umugambi wateguwe ku bisabwa nyakuri imbere y'itariki iheruka, aho kuwandika ku masaha 23 ijoro ribanza.
Ingingo z'imfashanyo n'ugutanga ibice vyanditswe ahantu impande zose zishobora gusoma, aho kuhuza mu butumwa.
Ibikorwa n'ibimenyetso bisuzumwa ku gihe, igihe umugambi ukiri gukora kandi ushobora kugororwa.
Abafise imigambi n'amashirahamwe atanga imfashanyo bakorera ku nyandiko imwe aho guhana verisiyo.

faq.title: Ivyo abantu baza kenshi.
faq.closingLink: Fungura konti idatwara amafaranga, hanyuma usome amatangazo.
faq.description: Ibibazo cumi na bibiri bigena ko urubuga rukoreshwa, bisubijwe ata rurimi rw'ubucuruzi. Aho inyishu y'ukuri ari yuko ikintu kitubatswe, ni co bivuga.

a.q1: Ubwoko bubiri bw'amatangazo: amahirwe y'imfashanyo, atanga amafaranga ku mugambi, n'amatangazo y'imigambi, atumira icifuzo. Buri tangazo rifise ishami, aho riri, incamake y'ukwemerwa, ibandiko risaba n'itariki yo gufunga. Igice c'ugushakisha kihitamwo ubwoko bwose uko ari bubiri kugira ngo ugabanye urutonde imbere yo gutangura gusoma.
a.q2: Buri tangazo ryerekana ikigero, kandi igihitamo kikwemerera kugabanya urutonde ku matangazo afunguye gusa. Itariki iheruka iri ku karita no mu bisobanuro vy'itangazo, kandi imenyesha ishobora kugenerwa kuri buri mukoresha kugira ngo itariki yo gufunga itabe ikintu ugomba kwibuka.
a.q3: Inyandiko y'umugambi ifise intego zawo, ingengo y'imari n'ibandiko, hamwe n'ivyo itangazo ryihariye risaba. Kubera ko ibandiko bijanwa ku mugambi aho kuba ku kibazo, umugambi wateguwe rimwe ushobora gutangwa ku matangazo menshi nta gushira ikintu ukundi. Umufasha wa AI atanga urutonde rw'ibandiko itangazo risaba.
a.q4: Ikibazo gifise ikigero n'amateka aho kuba ikimenyetso kimwe c'uko catanzwe canke kitatanzwe, kugira ngo ubone intambwe kigereye. Ko ikibazo catanzwe gishobora guhindurwa canke kitashobora bivana n'amategeko y'itangazo bwite, avugwa mu bisobanuro vyaryo; urubuga rwerekana intambwe, ntirutsinda amategeko y'uwutanga imfashanyo.
a.q5: Bihagije kugira ngo bisuzumwe: ivyo umugambi uzokora, ku bandu ki, mu gihe kingana iki, ku kiguzi kingana iki, n'ukuntu uzomenya ko vyakunze. Umugambi uremwa imbere y'uko usaba itangazo, bisobanura ko ushobora gutegura ku bisabwa nyakuri aho kuwandika ku itariki iheruka.
a.q6: Imfashanyo yatanzwe ijangwa ku mugambi hamwe n'urugendo rw'ugutanga ibice. Buri gice candikwa uko gitangwa, kugira ngo umusaba abone ivyemejwe, ivyashitse n'igikurikira. Urubuga rwandika urugendo n'aho rugereye; ntiruba ikigo c'imari ubwaco.
a.q7: Ibandiko umugambi canke itangazo risaba — ivyemezo vy'iyandikwa, integuro z'akazi, ingengo y'imari, inyandiko z'igitekerezo, politiki. Buri dosiye ishirwa mu bwoko kandi ifise ikigero c'isuzuma, kandi iboneka ku mpande zijanye n'uwo mugambi aho gutangazwa. Ibandiko bibikwa ku nyandiko y'umugambi kugira ngo bigume kumwe mu buzima bwose bw'umugambi.
a.q8: Ku bisabwa biteguye, buri mugenzuzi ahabwa ibibazo vyihariye na buri nota yandikwa ku nshingano yayo. Ingingo y'uguhitamo ibikwa ku kibazo, ni co gituma ico cisubizo gisobanurwa ku musaba akibaza. Urubuga ntifata ingingo na imwe ubwaco; rwandika ibisabwa, amanota n'ingingo.
a.q9: Ubwishuru bwandikwa ku gice catanzwe, kugira ngo igice gishobore guhuzwa uko igikorwa gitangwa aho kuba rimwe ku mpera. Uwutanga imfashanyo n'uwufise umugambi babona inyandiko imwe, ivyo bikuraho uguhuza gukora mu butumwa ku mpera y'igihe c'ivyerekanwa.
a.q10: Isigura itangazo, ihindura ibisabwa vy'ukwemerwa urutonde, itanga urutonde rw'ibandiko bikenewe, yoroshya inyandiko igoye, ihindura ibisobanuro mu ndimi kandi ikurongoza ku ntambwe ikurikira y'ikibazo. Ntifata ingingo y'imfashanyo, ntiyitamwo abasaba, kandi ntitanga ingingo ya nyuma y'ukwemerwa. Izo ngingo ni iz'abayobora itangazo.
a.q11: Icongereza, igifaransa, ikirundi n'ikiswahili. Igihitamo kiri mu ruranda rw'ibanze kandi ihitamwo ribikwa kuri iki gikoresho, kandi rigena n'ururimi rw'urupapuro kugira ngo ibisoma rupapuro n'ubuhinduzi bw'umushashari bikore neza. Imikurikiranyo n'ibisobanuro vy'urupapuro bihinduwe mu ndimi zine zose; inyandiko bwite y'itangazo iguma mu rurimi ryanditswe.
a.q12: Kwinjira guhindura ibimenyetso vyawe mu tweme two gukoresha igihe gito aho kuba ikiringo kibikwe, kandi urubuga rwubatswe n'inshingano z'ishirahamwe, z'umugenzuzi n'iz'umuyobozi. Ibandiko bijanye n'umugambi aho kuba ku mugaragaro. Hari ibintu bibiri vy'ukuri: ugushira mu ngiro inshingano biracari gukorwa mu bisabwa vy'uburenganzira vy'API, kandi gusohoka ubu bisiba utweme kuri iki gikoresho gusa, kuko API itarafise aho yo gusubiza.

finalCta.title: Umahirwe wawe ukurikira usanzwe uranditswe ahariho.
finalCta.note: Amatangazo, imigambi n'ibibazo bigaragara kuri uru rupapuro ni inyandiko z'ingero. Indimi zine z'urubuga zirakora, kandi ibisobanuro vy'urupapuro bihinduwe hamwe na zo.
details: Raba urutonde rw'amatangazo afunguye, uhitamwo ku ishami, aho biri n'itariki iheruka.
Fungura konti kugira utegure umugambi kandi ubike ibandiko vyawo ahantu hamwe.
Iyandikishe ishirahamwe kugira utangaze amatangazo kandi ucunge ibibazo ubona.

footer.tagline: Urusobe rw'abafatanyabikorwa rwo gushakisha amahirwe no kuyobora inzira y'ingaruka.

resilienceGrants.title: Imfashanyo z'ukwihangana kw'abaturage
resilienceGrants.summary: Ifasha ibikorwa vy'ukwihindurira uko ari mu karere — amazi, ubutaka, imenyesha ry'akaga n'ukwihangana kw'ingo — bikorwa n'amashirahamwe ari mu karere kagenderwaho.

learningCommunities.title: Itangazo ry'imirwi y'inyigisho
learningCommunities.amount: Ingengo y'imari y'umugambi gushika kuri USD 40 000
learningCommunities.summary: Itangazo ry'icifuzo ryubaka imirwi y'inyigisho iramba mu baturage: amashirahamwe y'ishure, imirwi y'inyigisho mu baturage n'imirongo y'inyigisho y'abantu bakuru.

youthEnterprise.title: Imfashanyo y'ibikorwa vy'urwaruka
youthEnterprise.summary: Amafaranga yo gukoresha n'ubujyanama ku bashinga b'urwaruka, hakundwa ibikorwa birema akazi mu karere.

maternalHealth.title: Umugambi w'ubuzima bw'abavyeyi mu baturage
maternalHealth.summary: Harondera abafatanyabikorwa bo gushira mu ngiro ubuzima bw'abavyeyi mu baturage, harimwo inzira zo kuhereza abarwayi n'amahugurwa y'abafasha b'abavyeyi.
eligibility: Ishirahamwe ry'ubuzima ridaharanira inyungu canke ivuriro ryemewe

digitalAccess.title: Imfashanyo z'ugushika ku koranabuhanga mu ntara
digitalAccess.summary: Ibikoresho, interineti n'amahugurwa ku baturage bo mu ntara, hashimikwa uburyo bwo gukoresha hamwe aho kugabura ibikoresho ku muntu ku wundi.

governanceCivics.title: Inyigisho z'ubwenegihugu n'ubuyobozi bw'ahaho
governanceCivics.summary: Imigambi y'inyigisho z'ubwenegihugu yubaka ugutahura kw'abaturage ku buyobozi bw'ahaho, ingengo y'imari ya Leta n'uburenganzira bw'abenegihugu.
